whatsNew.title: There is something new
whatsNew.body_one: One new step was added to the tour. Would you like to see it?
whatsNew.body_other: {{count}} new steps were added to the tour. Would you like to see them?

welcome.title: Welcome to the Arweqah platform
welcome.body: A short tour of the most important places and what you can do in each, by your permissions. You can skip it at any time and restart it later from your account menu.

account-menu.title: Your account
account-menu.body: Your name in the top bar opens your account menu: your profile, security, sign-out and this tour.

profile.title: My profile
profile.body: Change your language and theme (light or dark), see your work details kept by HR, and edit your contact details.

can.update: Edit your phone, personal e-mail and English name

my-access.title: My access
my-access.body: See what you may do on the platform and which role or group gives you each permission.

can.export: Export your permissions to a file

security.title: Security
security.body: The authenticator app you sign in with, your open sessions, and how to keep your account safe.

sign-out.title: Sign out
sign-out.body: Leave the platform from here when you are done, especially on a shared device.

language-theme.title: Language and theme
language-theme.body: Switch between Arabic and English, and between the light and the dark theme. Your choice is saved in your account.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: The bell tells you what concerns you: a reply to your ticket, a task assigned to you, or a mention of your name in a conversation. Press it for the latest five, or open the full page with its filters.

sidebar.title: The side menu
sidebar.body: Every page you may open, in groups. Press a group to open it.

finish.title: That is the tour
finish.body: You are ready. You can restart the tour at any time from your account menu. Good luck!

admin-mode.title: Admin mode
admin-mode.body: The administration pages appear only while this mode is on, with a fresh code from the authenticator app, and it switches off by itself after some idle time. It keeps you from changing something important by mistake.

tour-settings.title: Welcome tour settings
tour-settings.body: Control this tour itself: reword each step in Arabic and English, switch off the ones you do not want, and reorder the steps. The original wording is kept and you can go back to it.

can.edit: Reword a step and switch it off
can.reset: Reset a step to its original wording

captcha-settings.title: Bot protection
captcha-settings.body: Switch on the Cloudflare Turnstile check on the sign-in page: enter the site key and the secret key, try them, and it can be activated only after the test passes. With no active provider no check is asked.

can.test: Try the keys with the real widget
can.activate: Switch the check on and off

ai-settings.title: AI service
ai-settings.body: Switch on the AI that places the parts of a title file when the fixed reader cannot: enter the Anthropic key, try it, and it can be activated only after the test passes. With no active service the «Analyse with AI» button is not offered.

can.edit: Edit the key and the model
can.activate: Switch the AI service on and off

settings.title: Welcome tour steps
settings.description: The tour every employee sees on first sign-in, and the administration tour for administrators. Reword a step, switch it off or move it. The steps themselves (what is highlighted and where) are fixed in the system.
settings.dialogHint: Leave a field empty to show the original wording. Plain text, no formatting.
settings.shown: The step is shown in the tour
settings.resetDone: The step is back to its original wording.

reset.title: Reset the step to the original?
reset.description: The step’s wording, order and visibility go back to what the system has.

navHint: Open “{{page}}” from here at any time.
